name: Safire
source:
Safire is a Fell initiate. After being groomed for an assassin's guild at an early age, Safire has many talents. While the Fell leadership have fast-tracked Safire's training, her initiation into the ranks of the Fell assassins has been delayed while she works as a go-between for [url=https://vndb.org/c165700]Annie[/url] and the Fell.
